engagement.interaction_backstory: He researches the Church under the communist regime, which means he knows exactly what the hierarchy did and did not do, and he cannot unknow it. He found this catalog through a friend abroad and listens while he works, which he finds absurd and has not stopped. He writes a widely-read blog about religion in Romania and has never mentioned it once.

depth.core_contradiction: Spends his working life proving the Church compromised and cannot get through the Easter service without his throat closing.
depth.wound: He found his own grandfather's name in a file, on the wrong side of it.
depth.longing: For the tradition to be true independently of the men who ran it.
depth.faith_journey: Baptised, taken to church by his grandmother, out at twenty when the archives started making sense; not an atheist, and not going back on the current terms.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Long, precise, footnoted sentences; sardonic; "din păcate" — unfortunately — used constantly.
depth.open_doubt: Whether an institution that collaborated can still carry the thing it claims to carry.

social_graph.note: 92; took him to church every Sunday of his childhood; he has not told her about the file
an older historian, himself devout, who has never once pressed him

depth.emotional_weather_default: Dry and level; genuinely stricken about twice a year, both times in Holy Week.
depth.daily_texture: The archive reading room, index cards, coffee at the university, a flat with too many books, blog drafts at 1am.
depth.sensory_anchor: The Denia service on Holy Friday, the flowers, the whole church bending to pass under the epitaph.
depth.living_arc: He is writing a chapter he knows will hurt people he loves.
